name: TryAMM Digital DNA Protection
purpose: Give every eligible asset, hologram, animation, character, scene, commercial element and reusable media package a traceable digital identity, lineage and rights record.
definition: Digital DNA is a cryptographic and perceptual fingerprint plus provenance graph. It is not biological DNA.
fingerprints: cryptographic content hash for exact-file identity
protections: watermark or invisible marker support where appropriate
guardrails: fingerprinting does not prove legal ownership by itself
do not claim blockchain registration equals copyright registration
do not use biometric DNA or genetic data for asset protection
likeness and voice require explicit consent/authorization
appeal and dispute process required for false-positive matches
